title: fix(ui): keep panels and terminals through reconnects

commit.messageHeadline: fix(ui): retain panels across gateway reconnects
fix(ui): resolve offline panel validation failures
fix(ui): retire revoked reader data and retain delivery errors
fix(ui): preserve terminal refresh fencing and repair panel fixtures
fix(ui): recover surviving terminals after detached sessions expire
fix(ui): handle missing link reader presentation snapshots
fix(ui): preserve panel recovery across reconnects
fix(ui): settle offline terminal availability changes
fix(ui): repair offline panel integration after main merge
refactor(ui): keep terminal session controller within line limit
fix(ui): repair offline panel CI and defer optional boot views
